summary: Some employers pay severance as continuing salary, even if the person finds new work, so they do not delay the search.
realLife: HR guidance describes packages with severance pay, outplacement, continued health benefits and priority for internal openings, and suggests salary continuation continuing even after a new job starts.
sources: SHRM, Layoffs require communication, compassion, compliance: https://www.shrm.org/mena/topics-tools/news/talent-acquisition/layoffs-require-communication-compassion-compliance
inGame: needs: severance payments; the jobs module has pay on the job record but no severance flow.
